final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS f, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS r, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS n FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_ratio, SUM(g.n) AS total_projects, AVG(g.n - a.m) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.n > a.m
